versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ym-household-chore-split.
- Builds rotating household chore schedules based on member time, skills, preferences, and housing info.
- Estimates weekly workload balance; highlights differences and suggests adjustments if gaps exceed 30%.
- Includes "invisible chores" in cleaning lists and exports clear, fridge-ready chore charts and conflict resolution rules.
- Provides allocation rationale for each task; supports flexible chore assignment and specific rules for children.
- Outputs ready-to-use Markdown tables and clear instructions for real-life application.
